subject: Dedicated capacity mid-term amendment: pool resize vs node add-on options
messages:
From: Jordan Reyes <jor@storx.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@storx.io
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mid-term capacity uplift — urgent ask

Vanessa,

We're seeing a sustained +35% q/q increase in inference traffic for our customer-facing features. Our current Dedicated GPU pool (12 x A100-equivalent) was sized for last quarter's load and is now hitting queuing during peak hours. Procurement asked me to check mid-term options with you:

- Can we add GPUs to the existing pool mid-term or do we need a new commit?
- What does a mid-term uplift pricing amendment look like (monthly run-rate, proration, discount impact)?
- Any guarantees for throughput/latency if we add capacity? We need 99th percentile latency to remain under 150ms for 256-token responses.

Attached is a short usage extract and the spike timeline. We're targeting an extra ~8 GPUs or equivalent throughput. Can you put together options and a rough cost delta this week? Procurement will want a line-item monthly charge to attach to the PO.

Thanks,
Jordan Reyes
Head of ML Infrastructure
Storx

[attachment: Storx_Renewal_Req_2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reyes <jor@storx.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-term capacity uplift — urgent ask

Jordan — thanks for the details and the attachment. High level we have two clean paths that match your ask:

1) Mid-term amendment to increase committed GPUs on the current pool (prorated commit + updated monthly charge). Preserves billing simplicity and keeps the pool routing intact.
2) Short-term burst + dedicated node add-on: temporary node additions billed at a higher unit rate but without changing your core commit; useful if you expect the spike to normalize.

Quick numbers (ballpark):
- Add 8 GPUs via amendment: ~+$42k/month list, with a prorated charge for the remainder of the term.
- Add 8 GPUs as burst nodes: ~$58k/month equivalent while active (no commit).

Throughput/latency: with 8 additional A100-eq GPUs we project a 40–45% reduction in queueing for your peak distribution; 99p latency for 256 tokens should be under 150ms in our staging profiles, assuming similar token distribution to what you attached. We'll have Karthik run a short perf profile on your workload to confirm.

Looping in Karthik for precise throughput guarantees, pricing grid, and amending options so procurement has a PO-ready figure.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

[attachment: Storx_usage_nov.csv (csv)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reyes <jor@storx.io>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-term capacity uplift — sizing & pricing options

Jordan, Vanessa — I ran a quick model based on the CSV you attached and a profiling run on a representative batch of your inference requests. Key notes:

- Sizing: current 12 GPUs -> to hit your target headroom we recommend 20 GPUs (add 8). That gets you to steady-state headroom ~30–45% depending on token variance.
- Throughput guarantee: For a 20-GPU pool we can commit to a best-effort throughput SLA of X tokens/sec per GPU (we'll quantify after one quick validation run). For contractual latency guarantees (99p < 150ms) we recommend a canary validation window and a 14-day SLA ramp.
- Pricing options: see attached commit_pricing_grid.csv for full tiers. Highlights:
  * Mid-term amendment (prorated): one-time prorated charge for the remainder of term + new monthly committed charge.
  * Discount: standard renewals get 8–10% based on term. For mid-term amendments we can offer a 10% uplift discount on the incremental commit if you sign the amendment within 10 business days. If you prefer a temporary burst we can add nodes at on-demand rates (no discount).

Example (illustrative, not final):
- Incremental monthly run-rate (after 10% uplift discount): $37,800/mo for +8 GPUs committed.
- On-demand burst equivalent while active: ~$52,000/mo.
- Proration: prorated portion of list monthly charge for days remaining in term, then new monthly starts on amendment effective date.

Next steps I suggest: 1) confirm whether you want the committed uplift or burst path, 2) let us run a 4-hour validation profile during a low-risk window (we'll need API keys + test traffic). I can turn the pricing grid into a PO-ready line item once you confirm.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[attachment: commit_pricing_grid.csv (csv)]

From: Jordan Reyes <jor@storx.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-term capacity uplift — sizing & pricing options

Thanks Karthik — that layout helps. Two quick clarifications before I send to procurement:

1) Can you confirm the 99p latency guarantee language you would include in the amendment? Procurement wants firm wording around "99th percentile latency for 256-token responses < 150ms, measured over a 30-day rolling window" or a clear alternative we can accept that won't trigger frequent credit requests.
2) For the 10% uplift discount on the incremental commit, do you apply that discount to the incremental monthly charge only or to the entire renewed monthly run-rate?

If you can turn the numbers into a simple table (monthly recurring delta, one-time proration amount, effective date assumption) that's perfect. We're aiming for an amendment effective Dec 1 if feasible.

-Jordan

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reyes <jor@storx.io>, procurement@storx.io
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Storx — Dedicated amendment (final quote & next steps)

Jordan / Procurement team — moving this to formal quote and next steps. Thank you for the patience while we finalized pricing. Summary below: 

Amendment summary (effective 2026-12-01):
- Change: increase Dedicated GPU pool from 12 -> 20 (add 8 GPUs)
- Incremental committed monthly charge (post-discount): $34,200/mo
- One-time prorated charge (Nov 15 -> Nov 30 at list rates): $9,560 (will be invoiced on signing)
- Discount: 12% applied to incremental commit for signing amendment by 2026-11-30 (we approved an elevated uplift discount due to account strategic priority)
- Throughput & latency: amendment includes a validation canary (14 days) with an objective to meet 99p < 150ms for 256-token responses; if objective is not met we will agree a remediation plan and a limited SLA credit scope (standard amendment language attached).

Attachments: Storx_Dedicated_Amendment_v2.pdf (this contains the line-item table, legal amendment language, and signature block). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-Storx-Amendment

Next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm PO information and return PO to contracts@redwood.com.
2) Sign amendment via DocuSign.
3) We process proration and schedule a 4-hour validation profile ahead of effective date.

If you want the temporary burst path instead we can provide an addendum quote but note it has a higher monthly run-rate and no commit discount.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
